name: terminal-hub
description: Keeps one terminal open, starts with side bars closed, and installs Claude Code Manager from Open VSX when missing.

terminalHub.keepOneTerminal.description: Open a new terminal when the last terminal closes and no other tab is open, instead of leaving an empty window.

terminalHub.installManager.description: Install Claude Code Manager from Open VSX on startup when it is missing.

terminalHub.closeSideBarsOnStartup.description: Start with both side bars closed so only the terminal is visible. Ctrl+Alt+M opens Claude Code Manager.
